statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: This command is used to initiate a mail transaction. The MAIL command may be sent only when no mail transaction is in progress. This command clears the reverse-path buffer, the forward-path buffer, and the mail data buffer, and it inserts the reverse-path information from its argument clause into the reverse-path buffer.
actions: insert reverse-path information into reverse-path buffer

statements.guard_semantics: MAIL command is only valid when transaction.in_progress = false
